segments.dry: A post-menopausal reviewer with quite dry skin reported the mask really helped with her dryness, leaving her skin hydrated.
segments.sensitive: One reviewer with sensitive, redness-prone skin used a calming toner before applying the mask and found her face felt clean and tighter afterward.
segments.mature: Reviewers in their 40s to 70s report smoother fine lines, softer wrinkles, plumper skin, and in some cases smaller pores or lightened dark spots, though one in her mid-50s found deeper lines barely responded and the results faded within days.

concerns.aging: Many reviewers report smoothed fine lines, softer wrinkles around the mouth and eyes, and a plumper, firmer look, sometimes lasting only three to four days after a single use; however, at least two reviewers found the mask's own creases temporarily imprinted hard lines or wrinkle-like marks onto their skin, and one reviewer saw no visible change at all the next morning.
concerns.dehydration: Most reviewers describe the mask as deeply hydrating, leaving skin soft, plump, and glowing for days after use; a couple of reviewers, however, felt the product did nothing noticeable and consider the marketing overhyped relative to the results.
concerns.redness: One reviewer had a severe reaction with burning, swelling, and redness within minutes and had to remove the mask early, while another reported no irritation or redness at all.
concerns.spots: One reviewer reported her dark spots visibly lightened after a few weeks of regular use, alongside smoother wrinkles and shrunken pores.
concerns.blemishes: A couple of reviewers say the mask doesn't cause breakouts, but two others report it made them break out, with one describing itching and one describing welts forming within minutes of application.
concerns.oiliness: A couple of reviewers with visibly large pores report their pores looked smaller after using the mask.

aspects.libelle: Jelly-like texture that's delicate and can tear
Slides or slips before it sets in place
Requires lying still for 1.5-3 hours to work
High price for the number of masks included
Turns clear as a visual done-signal

extraits.texte: I was so excited to take it off the next day. I woke up with hard lines that weren’t there before. Even after my shower I had hard lines. This is not the answer, I think it’s another ploy. Posted one side of face effected negatively with hard lines, other side-normal/not noticeable improvement. Another bad part, gave my friend a mask as a gift.

This product was horrible. I had a very bad reaction to it and it was only on my face for 5 minutes. I put some of the serum on my neck and that's when I noticed the welts starting form in about 5 minutes, so I took the whole thing off my face. My face burned, was swollen and red.

Guess I’m either too old (56) or something else but while I like this product I don’t see the hype. I have used it twice. I kept it on for 3 hours. It does help with some lines. The deeper the lines the less noticeable treatment. Finer lines it worked great. The effects last 3-4 days then things go back to the natural you. The one thing that bugged me was the results next to the nose. It did plump up my skin where there are no lines, like the cheeks and next to nose area. My dislike was then it gave a slightly puffy appearance. I prefer not having a puffy face. After removing the mask I still felt the need for extra serum. Yes I added serum before applying mask too. All in all I would not purchase again. For the cost it’s not worth it for me.

extraits.titre: Very Happy with the results I have always wanted!
extraits.texte: Amazing ! I saw results right away, and I bought more. I use them 2 times a week as directed and I am finally happy with the way my skin looks. I am 51 with medium to fine lines and winkles around my eyes and mouth （marionette lines） and lines between my brows （theses are the most stubborn for me ). Application is very easy and the mask begins to sit comfortably on your face after about 5 minutes, after that it stays put. I use the eye extra pieces for my neck, and i keep the mouthpiece where it us and use that for my lips. I have slept in the mask, its durable and it stays put till I take it off in the morning completely clear, my skin is glowing after i take it off, all I need is my daily tinted moisturizer. I am starting to see wrinkles become smoother, my poor's on my chin have shrunken, and my dark sports have lightened up a good bit. It's only been a few weeks of using these masks. I feel amazing, and moisturized!

extraits.titre: Seems to work well but idk haha
extraits.texte: I mean, so far so good? I had it on for 3.5 hours and used the mouth/eye hole slots under my eyes and on my saggy chin. My face feels clean and tighter for sure. I tried to take photos throughout the process at different times. Some spots never dried due to overlapping the mask. I have sensitive skin and redness. I washed my face with water and used a Korean toner for redness beforehand. I’m pumped to use it again during the day to see if there is more visual changes. 24 hour update - my skin is shiny and def feels tighter!

I bought these masks after seeing many ads on Instagram. I’ve used a couple of the masks and they perform as advertised. The collagen takes about 2 hours to fully penetrate the skin and make the mask clear and ready to peel off. I was left with nicely hydrated skin. I’m post-menopausal and my skin can be quite dry, but these masks have really helped with the dryness. The mask can be a bit slippery and may slide down when you first put it on, but once it starts penetrating it stays in place. I will definitely be buying more.
Love the feel in my face and my skin is brighter. Kept the mask for 3 hours it is recommended for 2 hrs. I am over 40, with big pores, but after using this mask notice smaller pores.
